“Missing the goal happens to every player. Use it as a learning moment:

1. Plant your foot next to the ball — aim your toes toward your target.
2. Keep your eyes on the ball — don’t rush your shot.
3. Strike with the correct part of your foot — use your laces for power or inside of your foot for accuracy.
4. Follow through toward the goal — your body direction controls the shot.
5. Adjust and try again — analyze where the ball went and correct your angle.”

500 Calorie Meal Prep, Episode 7:
BUFFALO CHICKEN MAC N CHEESE

Check out my digital cookbook (in bio) for 90+ macro friendly recipes just like this one 👌

Ingredients:
325g pasta
300g 2% cottage cheese
150g 1/3 fat cream cheese
25g Cheddar powder
75g Buffalo sauce
30g soy sauce
30g honey

Chicken:
18oz Boneless skinless chicken thighs
Slice in strips
40g Buffalo sauce
20g soy sauce
Lightly coat with old bay seasoning, garlic powder & smoked paprika

Grill:
Preheat grill on high heat for 10 mins (closed)
Cook chicken 2 mins on each side (close lid)

Air fry:
Preheat to 400, add strips for 12 minutes (work in batches if it’s too crowded)

Garnish with chives or parsley + extra Buffalo sauce drizzle
